children: USD.AI is scheduled to release at least 147.12 million CHIP in its June 2027 supply unlock. The tokens are allocated to investors and team members under a monthly vesting schedule.

The announced amount equals 7.36% of the circulating supply. The release lifts the vesting restriction on this batch of tokens. Investors and team members can then sell CHIP from their unlocked allocations.

title: USD.AI: Vesting release unlocks at least 147.12 million CHIP - Jun 2027
